// APIs generated by Microsoft.Windows.CsWin32 into the internal Windows.Win32.PInvoke class.
// Undocumented APIs (SetWindowCompositionAttribute, the uxtheme dark-mode ordinals) and
// hand-rolled shell interop (SHGetFileInfo in IconProvider, ShellContextMenu) are NOT here —
// CsWin32 cannot express them, so they stay hand-written. A few documented calls also stay
// hand-written where a local struct (RECT/POINT) is woven through the surrounding math or a
// SafeHandle/ANSI change would alter behavior; those are noted at their call sites.
